title: Check-in from 14:00
description: Public listings show check-in from 14:00 to 24:00. Please call reception if your arrival time may change.

title: Check-out until 12:00
description: Check-out is listed until 12:00 unless another arrangement is confirmed directly with reception.

title: Confirm current availability by phone
description: Room rates, availability, bed setup and optional services can change by date, so confirm details by calling +38 067 510-15-04.

title: Respect quiet hours and other guests
description: Please keep noise low in rooms and corridors, especially at night and early morning.

title: Non-smoking rooms
description: Public listings mention non-smoking rooms. Follow hotel rules and staff instructions about smoking areas.

title: Guest responsibility for room condition
description: Guests are responsible for the room, furniture, towels, keys and equipment during their stay.

title: Wi-Fi and parking details
description: Wi-Fi and parking or street parking are listed publicly. Ask reception for current access and parking guidance.

title: Meals are not confirmed as a hotel restaurant service
description: Hotels24 says meals are not provided at the hotel. Nearby food options are available; any breakfast-in-room or room-service references should be confirmed before publishing as active.

title: Family rooms by availability
description: Family triple room categories are listed publicly. Confirm exact bed setup, room view and current rate when booking.

title: Pet policy must be confirmed
description: Pet rules are not confirmed enough for an official claim on this site. Please contact reception before arriving with a pet.
